start: A gym member: member of a gym that has its own colour, tone or logo

user_sees: At the top: the gym's logo, small (whole, never cut into a circle), and the gym's name on one line
must_not: Another gym's logo or name
A wide logo squeezed or cropped

user_sees: The same logo and name at the top
must_not: A different name or logo from the Workout tab

steps.action: Turn on the screen reader and touch the mark
must_not: The logo read out as an unnamed picture

start: A gym member: member of a gym that has its own colour, tone or logo

user_sees: The gym's logo and name at the top, as on the Workout and Profile tabs
must_not: A Shop tab with no sign of whose gym it is
A mark that differs from the other two tabs

start: A gym member: member of a gym with no look of its own, or of no gym

steps.action: Open the Workout tab and the Profile tab
user_sees: No gym mark; the tabs start with their usual top
must_not: An empty gap where the mark would be
A gym name with no gym joined

steps.action: In a branded gym whose logo cannot load, open the Workout tab
user_sees: A small dot in the gym's colour and the gym's name
must_not: A broken-picture mark
The name missing too

start: A gym member: member of a branded gym, mark showing

steps.action: The gym changes its logo and colour; bring the app back to the front when no workout is open
user_sees: Logo, name and colours change together
must_not: The new logo over the old colours, or the other way round

user_sees: The mark is gone from Workout and Profile
must_not: The left gym's name still at the top
A mark that needs an app restart to return
